recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s square album cover featuring a centered close-up portrait of a male vocalist against a soft-focus outdoor background, topped by a prominent yellow horizontal banner containing bold, italicized typography.
coreVisualRelationships: A bright yellow octagonal-clipped banner anchored to the top edge.
A centered, medium-close portrait as the primary visual focus.
A high-contrast relationship between the dark hair/clothing stripes and the light background.
A hierarchical text stack within the banner using varying weights of the same typeface family.
coreInvariants: Yellow header block with a thin green border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered male figure from the chest up, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated yellow header block at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title in the yellow block, moves down to the artist's name, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus space around the head, creating a halo effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream and off-white in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the header background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark forest green for the header border and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header block contrasts with the muted, natural tones of the photographic portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Must use a deep 'hunter green' for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide slab serif with a strong italic slant.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes for internal consistency.
graphicDevices: Octagonal clipped corners on the header box
Thin double-line border around the text area

preserve: Dark green on yellow color scheme

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and mid-century feel.
Provides the necessary width and stroke contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of a man in a 1960s cardigan, centered, with a soft-focus outdoor garden background. Leave the top 25% of the image clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bright yellow horizontal banner with clipped corners and a thin green border at the top. Center three levels of dark green italic slab-serif text within the banner.

verificationChecks: Is the header banner yellow with green text?
Is the font a heavy, italicized slab serif?
Is the portrait centered and in a 1960s style?
Are the corners of the yellow box clipped at 45-degree angles?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of green for the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the graphic banner

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the yellow banner does not obscure the subject's head.
Verify the 'slab' nature of the font serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered vintage-style portrait with a top-aligned, color-blocked typographic header using high-contrast slab serifs.
